d: Dark espresso hair is long, swept back from the forehead and falling to the shoulders, paired with a groomed goatee and focused, dark brown eyes. The face is that of a mature adult with a muscular, athletic build. The outfit consists of a gold and black cuirass over a white undergarment with fringed epaulets, a gold-and-white waist belt with hanging fabric strips, golden bracers, and matching golden greaves worn over dark brown sandals. A white strap crosses the chest diagonally.
